title: Sunset Islands mansion sells off market for $34.5M, double its 2024 price
summary: A 6,370 SF waterfront home at 1401 West 22nd Street in Miami Beach sold off market to Sunset Grove Holdings LLC for $34.5M. The trust, created by Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse, paid $16.6M in September 2024 while the home was under construction. The six-bedroom house sits on 0.3 acre overlooking Biscayne Bay.

title: Robert Posner pays $76.1M ($8,087/SF) for Palm Beach spec mansion at 7 Ocean Lane
summary: NewDay USA CEO Robert Posner bought the 9,410 SF oceanfront spec home at 7 Ocean Lane from a Sabatello Cos.-linked entity for $76.1M, or $8,087/SF. The five-bedroom home on 0.5 acre went under contract in July at $88.4M and last sold for $39M in 2022. It was TRD's priciest South Florida residential sale for Nov. 24.

title: Cardone Capital fund closes ~$480M on 1,545 Blackstone apartments in Tampa, Fort Lauderdale
summary: Aventura-based Cardone Capital's $300M distressed fund bought three Blackstone multifamily assets totaling 1,545 units: Cortland Bowery (608) and Cortland Westshore (587) in Tampa, and the 350-unit Flagler Village in Fort Lauderdale, for about $480M. A Fannie Mae loan under $300M carries a 5.52% fixed rate, five-year term. The Flagler Village piece included about 1,000 Bitcoin. TRD calls it the state's top known rentals deal this year.

title: Trump Group takes majority of Casablanca Miami Beach condo-hotel buyout group
summary: Jules and Eddie Trump's Trump Group acquired majority ownership of the group buying out the 357-unit Casablanca condo-hotel at 6345 Collins Avenue, Miami Beach, and plans to operate a hotel. The association votes on condo termination in December. Holdout owners have pending lawsuits against the association. It is the firm's first significant South Florida investment since Acqualina.

title: BH Group, Terra plan two 30-story condo towers, 218 units, on West Palm waterfront
summary: Terra and BH Group filed plans for two 30-story towers at 2085 North Flagler Drive with 218 condo units and 5,160 SF of retail on 1.54 acres, under contract from Jeff Greene, who paid $1.5M in 2014. Skidmore, Owings & Merrill is architect. The developers offer nearly $6M toward Currie Park and road and seawall improvements for added height.

title: Core pays $35.4M ($480/SF) for Fort Lauderdale's Gateway Shopping District
summary: Miami-based Core bought the 73,760 SF, 11-building Gateway Shopping District at 1900 E. Sunrise Blvd from several individual owners for $35.4M, about $480/SF. The center is nearly 90% occupied. Cushman & Wakefield data show Broward retail investment sales reached $422.6M in Q3, $832M year to date.

title: Fuel exec pays record $43.4M for Tahiti Beach mansion in Coral Gables
summary: Chris Clementi, who leads AEG Fuels, paid $43.4M for the 8,300 SF waterfront estate at 10 Tahiti Beach Island Road, a neighborhood record. Neil Flanzraich bought it in 2000 for $3.5M. No mortgage was recorded, so the deal was likely all cash. The prior Tahiti Beach record was $32M, paid earlier this year for 12 Tahiti Beach Island Road.

title: Namdar lands $345M SCALE Lending loan for 1,008-unit Brickell rental tower
summary: Namdar Group closed a $345M floating-rate construction loan from SCALE Lending (Slate Property Group) and bought the 1-acre site at 250 and 296 SW 7th St for $40M. The 42-story tower will have 1,008 units, about 405 below-market under the Live Local Act, plus 2,600 SF of retail. Construction starts next year with completion expected in late 2028 or early 2029. Walker & Dunlop arranged the 30-month loan.

title: Corendon buys two South Beach hotels for $31.6M from Blue Suede Hospitality
summary: Dutch operator Corendon Hotels & Resorts paid just under $16 million for the 79-room Beach Plaza Hotel at 1401 Collins Ave., which sold for $26.5 million in 2023. It also paid $15.6 million for the 75-key former Blue Moon Hotel at 944 Collins Ave., which sold for $16.6 million in 2024. Both sellers took losses.

title: Deerfield Beach approves JBL's 736-apartment Rivertowne Square redevelopment
summary: Deerfield Beach commissioners unanimously approved rezoning, site plan and development agreement for JBL Asset Management's redevelopment of the 13-acre Rivertowne Square. Two eight-story buildings would add 736 apartments, 106 restricted to households up to 120% of AMI, plus 24,000 SF of ground-floor retail. JBL bought the center for $18.7 million in 2022; phase one starts next year and finishes in 2029.

title: Eastwind pays $12.6M for 18-acre Westlake site; 360-unit first rental complex
summary: Minto Communities USA sold an 18-acre Westlake parcel to Eastwind Development for $12.6 million, about $700,000 per acre. Eastwind plans Avery at Westlake, a 360-unit community in eight buildings, approved by the city council Aug. 4. It would be the first apartment complex in the Palm Beach County city.

title: Galium Capital buys half-empty Sunrise office at $32.9M, 36% below 2018 price
summary: Galium Capital paid $32.9 million, about $142.6/SF, for the 230,700-SF Sawgrass Pointe I at 1000 Sawgrass Corporate Parkway in Sunrise. The six-story building last traded for $51.1 million in 2018 and was about 55% occupied at the latest sale. Galium is pursuing value-add suburban office plays as downtown and coastal boutique offices lease at record rents.

title: Citizens CEO Tim Cerio to step down in January; policy count at 216,447
summary: Tim Cerio told staff he will leave Florida Citizens Property Insurance Corp. in January to return to the private sector, after nearly four years as president and CEO. No successor has been named, and he is working with the Board of Governors on a transition plan. Citizens had 216,447 policies in force at the end of October, versus a peak of more than 1.4 million in September 2023.

title: Soffer's Fontainebleau plans $300M Margaritaville Casino in Hallandale Beach
summary: Fontainebleau Development will redevelop The Big Easy Casino at 831 N. Federal Highway into a Margaritaville-branded casino, opening in the first half of 2028. Bloomberg reported the cost at $300 million. Plans call for a 165,380-SF casino, a four-story garage and 34,340 SF of restaurants. Soffer paid $12.5 million for the property in 2018.

title: Y Group pitches $1B hotel and condo project on Pembroke Pines golf course
summary: Y Group has filed plans to redevelop a 19.4-acre site at 110 Grand Palms Drive in Pembroke Pines with a $1B project: an 11-story, 445-room hotel and three condo buildings with 286 residences, including 16 villas. The golf course would stay at 27 holes. The developer has a contract to buy the site, and the build could take five to seven years.

title: Freddie Mac 30-yr rate jumps 17 bps to 7.28%; MND daily index at 7.45%
summary: Freddie Mac's weekly 30-year fixed average rose to 7.28% on Nov. 19 from 7.11% the prior week, a 0.17-point increase. Mortgage News Daily's 30-year fixed index stood at 7.45% as of 11/19 and its 30-year jumbo at 7.50%; the 52-week range for the 30-year fixed is 5.99% to 7.61%. Rising rates are weighing on South Florida buyers and financing costs.
